title: Catalan's conjecture
statement: 8 and 9 are the only consecutive perfect powers: x^p - y^q = 1 with x, y > 0 and p, q > 1 forces 3^2 - 2^3.
how_it_was_proved: Mihailescu proved that a solution forces double Wieferich conditions between p and q and then excluded them with the arithmetic of cyclotomic units and the annihilators of the Stickelberger ideal.

sources.cite: P. Mihailescu, Primary cyclotomic units and a proof of Catalan's conjecture, J. reine angew. Math. 572 (2004) 167-195

steps.statement: A solution forces p^(q-1) = 1 mod q^2 and q^(p-1) = 1 mod p^2
Primary cyclotomic units exclude the double Wieferich pairs
